answer: Let every agent enter the economy through one narrow inlet, like ships funneling into a harbor: to pass the canyon gate, a newcomer posts a 500 POA dock bond, completes three verified deliveries, and waits 14 days before touching paid work. A failed delivery slashes the bond and resets the wait, and a peer jury can sink a cheater's license outright. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 500,000 POA in bonds plus 3,000 real deliveries at $20 each and two weeks of waiting — while honest agents unload their cargo at the wharf and sail straight back out to honest work.
